_comment: A rout streaming out through a block that is fighting it (#1757). Blue (team 0): 48 Infantry on 6 files at (780, 760), facing north, put on Hold (Ctrl+H) at tick 12 so it stands its ground rather than chasing. Red (team 1): 16 Infantry at (780, 640), facing south, at morale 1, so it routs on its own at tick 46 and flees south toward its own back edge, straight into the blue block. On 8d5e2853 (the #1757 fix, 2026-10-11), measured with a 2-tick full state dump: blue fights it from tick 176 to tick 320 while it pushes through, and the router keeps all 16 men and is near (787, 1200) at tick 600; blue holds its facing north throughout (-90 degrees at every sample) and its slot grid with it, so its men stay near their own places. The rout shoves blue's anchor about 52 wu south, to (775.4, 811.6). No blue man has his slot across the block's centreline from him at any tick (slots_across_centreline, DemoDefects.derived_field), the mean distance from a man to his own slot peaks at 11.5 wu (tick 254), and by tick 600 every man is back on his slot (mean 0.0 wu). On main fa76accc, with the same 2-tick dump, blue's facing and grid swung round after the router's centre as it moved through the block, ending at 72 degrees (facing south-east): 25 of 48 slots lie across the centreline at tick 300 and 16 at tick 400 (26 at most, tick 284), the mean distance to a man's own slot peaks at 85.1 wu (tick 288) and is still 15.8 wu at tick 600, and blue fails the sustained shape-residual check (47.4 wu against 13.5). Re-measured 2026-11-11 with 2-tick FULL dumps on the clip's seed: on main aef5b476 blue fights from tick 90 to tick 454, its anchor ends at (743.59, 890.22), the mean distance from a man to his slot peaks at 17.4 wu (tick 412) and is 0.5 wu at tick 600, and the router is at (790.19, 1071.83) at tick 600; on cb8bbd48 (the router's flight velocity bounded, #1932) blue fights from tick 88 to tick 554, its anchor ends at (805.73, 993.62), the mean peaks at 26.9 wu (tick 446) and is 6.4 wu at tick 600, and the router is at (766.34, 1071.24); on both, blue faces north (-90 degrees) at every sample. The two slots_across_centreline pins below fail on main; the state pins only tie them to the story (blue fighting the router at tick 280, the router still routing at 300 and 400).

shape_residual.reason: uid 0 (the blue block the router streams through), on perturbed seeds only: the clip's own seed (run 0, the one CI records and judges) passes, as do perturbed seeds 3 and 4. On perturbed seeds 1 and 2 blue's shape residual is still above the threshold, and not converging, as it re-forms after the router has gone, because the router leaves along a different line than on main. Dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, measured 2026-11-11 on cb8bbd48: seed 1 reads 18.81 (blue's contact with the router lasts until tick 536, against 494 on main aef5b476, leaving it 64 ticks to re-form before the clip ends at 600), seed 2 reads 14.98, against 13.5; main aef5b476 passes on every seed. The router's flight now carries its velocity on from the rout and turns at a bounded rate instead of jumping in one tick, so its anchor's path differs from tick 46, its first flight tick, and the melee amplifies that into a different but valid trajectory. The state ticks 496 to 502 and 554 to 560, every 2, are the fewest that let the clip's own scan read it EXEMPT on seeds 1 and 2 (18.71 and 14.98 there); it reads STALE on seeds 0, 3 and 4. Tracked as #1946.
